ev.q: Overall, 48 (31%) of 154 primary caregivers stated that they or someone else had premasticated food for the child
Black caregivers more frequently reported ever premasticating food, compared with non-blacks (37% versus 20%, respectively; PR = 1.8)
Prevalence of premastication of food for HIV-exposed children aged ≥6 months, by selected characteristics
31% of HIV-exposed children aged ≥6 months received premasticated food from a caregiver
Caregivers aged ≤19 years were significantly more likely to premasticate than those aged ≥40 years
CDC conducted a cross-sectional survey at nine such clinics

methods_quotes.q: CDC limited its analysis to caregivers of children who were aged ≥6 months at the time of investigation
this cross-sectional investigation included a convenience sample of caregivers of children seen in HIV clinics
